correctness.rationale: An explicit Laplacian recurrence c_(a+1)=-c_a (m-a)(m-a+beta)/((a+1)(a+1+alpha)) constructs one harmonic for every angular weight (u,v) with |u|+|v|<=k and k-|u|-|v| even. These (k+1)^2 distinct torus characters span H_k(S³); their radial factors are nonzero rational polynomials Q(s) with Q(0)=1. Since s=e^-1 is transcendental, no radial coefficient vanishes for any weight or degree. The grid evaluation matrix is therefore diagonalized into discrete characters modulo (N,M), and its rank equals the exact number of residues of the weight diamond W_k. Along coordinate axes the step-2 weights -k,-k+2,...,k force each period T to be odd T>=k+1 or even T>2k. Conversely, congruent differences must respect |du|+|dv|<=2k and even total parity; the allowed periods prevent nonzero collisions in all mixed parity cases. Thus the necessary/sufficient rectangular-grid rule and optimal (k+1)^2 even, (k+2)^2 odd site counts follow for every degree, including k=0 and size-one grids. Independently exhaustively enumerated 4056 (k,N,M) combinations through k=12 to check the alias criterion. This is finite corroboration, not the transcendental universal proof.
